title: Peapods Finance — Paired LP Token Reward Manipulation Analysis
root_cause: `depositFromPairedLpToken()` allows the slippage parameter to be set to 999 without input validation, enabling reward calculation manipulation
steps: → [1] Uniswap V2 Flash Swap: acquire large amount of pOHM
→ [2] Swap pOHM → PEAS via Uniswap V3
→ [4] Swap acquired PEAS → pOHM via Uniswap V3
